Can my pet travel in the cabin?
Some airlines allow small pets in the cabin on certain routes. Most dogs and larger pets travel as checked baggage or as cargo in a pressurised, temperature-controlled hold.
What does a pet need to enter India?
Typically a microchip, valid rabies vaccination, a government-endorsed health certificate and a quarantine no-objection certificate. Requirements can change, so we confirm them for every move.
